project.title: The distribution of bacterial communities  in poultry farm and surrounding environment
project.description: Antibiotic resistance poses a significant threat to human and animal health worldwide, with farms serving as crucial reservoirs of Antibiotic Resistance Genes (ARGs) and Antibiotic Resistant bacteria (ARB). However, the distribution of ARGs in poultry farms and their transmission patterns in the environment remain poorly understood. In this study, we collected samples of aerosol microorganisms, cloacal matter, soil, and vegetables from poultry farms and surrounding environments at three different distances. Our findings confirm that farms are important sources for environmental dissemination of both pathogens as well as antibiotic resistant genes.
